content.text:
I navigated through the Qatar Airways website to find the baggage allowance for economy class. However, the specific weight allowance was not directly visible within the sections loaded and displayed on the baggage information page.

To get the exact weight of baggage allowance for economy class on Qatar Airways, you typically need to:

- Visit the official Qatar Airways baggage information page (https://www.qatarairways.com/en/baggage.html).
- Look for sections detailing "Checked Baggage" allowance for "Economy Class." 
- Economy class baggage allowance can vary by route (piece concept for flights to/from the Americas, weight concept elsewhere), but usually it's either 23kg per piece (for piece concept) or 30kg total (for weight concept).

For up-to-date and route-specific information, I recommend using Qatar Airways’ official baggage allowance calculator or viewing their baggage policy page directly. If you need the exact allowance for a specific route, let me know your origin and destination and I can help further!
